definitions.gloss: branching stream; distributary; diversion of water flow
definitions.explanation: a stream that branches off from a main river or waterway; also the act of diverting water flow
the splitting or diversion of traffic, people, or processes into separate channels

examples.japanese: ⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{分流|ぶんりゅう}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The river branches into two streams.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{水量|すいりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}え→増える：01183_fueru⟧、{分流|ぶんりゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{氾濫|はんらん}→氾濫：09256_hanran⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The water volume increased from heavy rain, and the branch stream flooded.

examples.japanese: ⟦{用水路|ようすいろ}→用水路：19104_yousuiro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{通|とお}じて⟦{農地|のうち}→農地：14354_nouchi⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{分流|ぶんりゅう}⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Water is diverted to farmland through irrigation channels.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歩行者|ほこうしゃ}→歩行者：03152_hokousha⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{分流|ぶんりゅう}⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To separate the flow of pedestrians and bicycles.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{出口|でぐち}→出口：02508_deguchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{乗客|じょうきゃく}→乗客：03284_joukyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{分流|ぶんりゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{仕組|しく}み→仕組み：07168_shikumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{導入|どうにゅう}→導入：10127_dounyuu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A system to separate passenger flow at the station exit was introduced.

examples.japanese: ⟦{混雑|こんざつ}→混雑：02809_konzatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{緩和|かんわ}する→緩和する：19641_kanwasuru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{入場者|にゅうじょうしゃ}→入場者：23599_nyuujousha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{時間帯|じかんたい}→時間帯：12971_jikantai⟧ごと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{分流|ぶんりゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}てられた→立てる：01196_tateru⟧。
examples.english: A plan was made to split entrants into different time slots to ease congestion.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧ (divide; separate) + {流|りゅう} (flow; stream). Can be used as both a noun and a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb. The literal meaning involves water splitting into separate channels, while the figurative meaning applies to any flow (traffic, people, data) being divided.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {分流|ぶんりゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to branch off; to divert
- {分流|ぶんりゅう}⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧: to cause to branch/divert
- {分流|ぶんりゅう}⟦{地点|ちてん}→地点：04058_chiten⟧: point of diversion
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{流|なが}れ→流れ：03504_nagare⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{分流|ぶんりゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to separate the flow of people

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{支流|しりゅう}→支流：19624_shiryuu⟧: tributary — a stream that flows into a larger river (joining, not splitting)
- ⟦{合流|ごうりゅう}→合流：11902_gouryuu⟧: confluence; merging — the opposite of {分流|ぶんりゅう}, where streams or flows come together
- ⟦{分岐|ぶんき}→分岐：11770_bunki⟧: branching; fork — more general, used for roads, paths, and decision points
